description.en: Distinct hues for experimental groups and cell classes. Use shapes as well when accessibility matters.
description.zh-CN: 用于实验分组与细胞分类；需要无障碍辨识时同时使用点形。

description.en: Soft fills for bars and large areas; avoid tiny points or thin lines.
description.zh-CN: 适合柱形与大面积填色；避免用于细小散点和细线。

description.en: Three hue pairs, light then dark. Set category order explicitly to match your comparisons.
description.zh-CN: 三组同色深浅配对；请明确类别顺序，使配对与实验比较一致。

description.en: Low-to-high values such as expression or abundance. For signed correlations prefer a diverging palette.
description.zh-CN: 用于表达量、丰度等由低到高的数值；有正负的相关性优先使用发散色。

description.en: Negative–neutral–positive values, including correlation. Colors do not imply significance.
description.zh-CN: 用于负值—中性—正值，如相关性；颜色不代表统计显著性。
